nodes.label: Medication-Induced Parkinsonian Signs
nodes.rationale: Bradykinesia, rigidity or tremor with plausible medication timing still requires excluding Parkinson disease, catatonia and depressive slowing.

nodes.label: Simpson-Angus Scale
nodes.rationale: Ten-item 0-4 examination quantifies rigidity-dominant signs at one point in time; thresholds screen rather than diagnose or prove causation.
